dialogues.speaker: Helka
dialogues.text: The commission is complete. If you still want to challenge these gigantic creatures, however, I'm more than willing to come along.

choices.text: Let's head to the challenge location.
I've got other things I need to do at the moment.

dialogues.speaker: Helka
dialogues.text: Ready to tangle with the giant crab?

response.speaker: Helka
response.text: Nod-Krai is also home to crabs, but they look very different. Hmm. I should take a few more photos — for all I know, Maisie might like Fontainian crabs better.

response.speaker: Helka
response.text: But then again, I wonder... Is the appearance of a species like this a result of the hot spring, or is it the Tyrant's presence that caused the springs to boil?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Tell me a bit about Nod-Krai...

response.speaker: Helka
response.text: If I had to describe it, I'd go with "a dangerous yet lively place"? It's been leaning toward the former in recent days, though.

response.speaker: Helka
response.text: Before I left, the Fatui had moved a lot of construction materials in. Word was that a Harbinger — or Harbingers — were present, too. As for what they intend, I couldn't say.

response.speaker: Helka
response.text: I've heard bad things about the situation to the north as well. The Abyss's influence has been expanding... Katya even warned me not to return via the northern paths.

dialogues.speaker: Helka
dialogues.text: Ready to rumble with the giant ball of water?

response.speaker: Helka
response.text: So, the will of water can also manifest itself in such a form... Inconceivable. It really doesn't look as though it lacks a soul.

response.speaker: Helka
response.text: Katya once told me a story about a fisherman who fell in love with a spirit of pure water, but such entities have no souls, and thus the fisherman set out on a journey to discard his as well...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Could you tell me a bit about Katya?

response.speaker: Helka
response.text: She used to be a great adventurer back in the day, and her exploits took her all over the world. Eventually, her injuries led to her retirement, after which she settled down in Nasha Town.

response.speaker: Helka
response.text: She's always taken good care of us, and gave me lots of practical advice before I set out... I have immense respect for her, and am also immensely grateful to her.

response.speaker: Helka
response.text: Oh, right! If you get the chance, you should definitely try her cooking!

dialogues.speaker: Helka
dialogues.text: Ready to clash with the giant centaur statue?

response.speaker: Helka
response.text: This device was created by an ancient civilization, I believe. It appears like nothing so much as a musician on a stage. The society that created it must have been impressive indeed.

response.speaker: Helka
response.text: Katya said that Nod-Krai was also once home to an ordered and prosperous civilization, one that you can catch glimpses of from time to time.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I'd like to know a bit about this "Nod-Krai"...

response.speaker: Helka
response.text: Well, about that... Nod-Krai is actually part of Snezhnaya, and once upon a time, they performed lots of large scale development in the area.

response.speaker: Helka
response.text: But you can't find hide nor hair of that nowadays — unless you're talking about the mechanical scrap you can see everywhere.

response.speaker: Helka
response.text: But maybe that's precisely why Nod-Krai's become the bustling place it is today.

dialogues.speaker: Helka
dialogues.text: Ready to take on the giant mechanical monster?

response.speaker: Helka
response.text: I've seen relics of a similar stripe in Nod-Krai... Yeah, on the island where the Frostmoon Scions gather...

response.speaker: Helka
response.text: But they're all as dead as dead can be, so this is the first time I'm seeing one move the way this one does. Fascinating — I'll record this and tell Maisie all about it.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: So, who are these "Frostmoon Scions," again...?

response.speaker: Helka
response.text: They're a... weird bunch, I'd say? They're not like the people of Nasha Town at all, the way they live in the wilds and forests most of the time.

response.speaker: Helka
response.text: Word has it that they worship some moon deity, and you can find statues they've made all over Nod-Krai. As for the rest, I don't really know — Katya's warned me not to look into them too much.

response.speaker: Helka
response.text: But what I have seen them do is magic. It's a shocking sight, I'll tell you that.
